claim: Maaemo holds 3 Michelin stars and Kontrast holds 2 Michelin stars in the current Norway guide; Kontrast was upgraded from 1 to 2 in 2024.
quote: Maaemo (Contemporary cuisine) Current rating: 3 Michelin stars (2025) Maintained 3-star status since 2022. Kontrast (Nordic cuisine) Current rating: 2 Michelin stars (2025) Upgraded from 1 star in 2024.

claim: Maaemo is Oslo's only restaurant with three stars in the Michelin Guide and also holds a Green Star.
quote: Maaemo is Oslo's only restaurant with three stars in the Michelin guide. Located at Dronning Eufemias gate 23, it champions a farm-to-table philosophy with modern, creative, and contemporary Nordic cuisine.

claim: Maaemo opened December 2010, received 2 stars March 2012, 3 stars February 2016, lost all stars in February 2020 after closing the original site, and regained 3 stars in September 2021 at its new Bjørvika location.
quote: In March 2012, Maaemo became the first restaurant in the Nordic region to receive two stars... February 2016, the restaurant received its third Michelin star... In December 2019, the restaurant closed to move... lost all of its three Michelin stars in February 2020... In September 2021 Maaemo won back the three stars.

claim: Esben Holmboe Bang is the Danish-Norwegian chef-owner who leads Maaemo's kitchen.
quote: Esben Holmboe Bang... Danish-Norwegian Chef celebrated for redefining New Nordic cuisine with a strict focus on local, organic and wild ingredients.

claim: Maaemo accepts reservations via Exploretock and is the restaurant's primary booking channel.
Maaemo books on Tock and releases tables on a fixed monthly schedule.
Maaemo releases reservations on the 1st of each month at 12:00 CET, opening tables roughly two months ahead.
quote: Maaemo releases reservations on the 1st of each month at 12:00 PM CET, two months ahead of the desired booking.

claim: Maaemo is at Dronning Eufemias gate 23, 0194 Oslo, in the Bjørvika waterfront district near the Opera House.
quote: Maaemo - Dronning Eufemias gate 23, 0194 Oslo, Norway

claim: Maaemo serves a set tasting menu of 20+ dishes priced at NOK 4,500 (~USD 450).
quote: The tasting menu costs $450 (4,500 NOK). Maaemo serves a set tasting menu of more than 20 dishes.

claim: Maaemo's menu is built on Norwegian seasonal, organic, biodynamic and wild ingredients, aiming for an emotional dining experience.
quote: The team ensure every measure is taken to minimise their environmental footprint... All the food is made from seasonal, organic or biodynamic ingredients from Norwegian producers.

claim: Kontrast is chef-owned by Mikael Svensson, holds two Michelin stars and a Green Star, and sources ~98% of its produce locally.
quote: Mikael Svensson is the chef and owner of Kontrast in Oslo, a restaurant awarded two Michelin stars and a coveted Green Star... around 98% of the kitchen's produce sourced locally.

claim: Kontrast is located at Maridalsveien 15, 0175 Oslo and books via its own online system; cuisine described as contemporary Nordic.
quote: Maridalsveien 15, 0175 Oslo... Reservations available through their online booking system at kontrast.superbexperience.com/reserve/experience... Mikael Svensson (executive chef and owner)... exploring contemporary Nordic cooking, blending traditional techniques with modern flavors.

claim: Mikael Svensson grew up in Skåne, southern Sweden, and co-founded b.culture in 2020 to upcycle Kontrast's byproducts via fermentation.
quote: Born in Skåne, Sweden's southernmost county... In 2020, Mikael co-founded b.culture alongside co-owner Will Moffat, born from the idea of transforming byproducts from Kontrast into new, sustainable ingredients.

claim: Kontrast's dining room sits in the converted-industrial Vulkan district near the Akerselva river with stark, minimalist interiors; dishes layer complex technique under simple plating.
quote: Kontrast occupies the modern Vulkan development with stark interiors and an industrial edge, positioned near the Akerselva river... simple presentation masks the complex nature of what's served.

claim: Kontrast opened in 2013 and was awarded its first Michelin star in 2016 before being promoted to two stars in 2024.
quote: Chef Mikael Svensson established Kontrast in 2013... In 2016, the KONTRAST restaurant was awarded a Michelin star, and it was promoted from One to Two Michelin Stars at The Michelin Guide Nordic Countries Ceremony 2024.

claim: Kontrast's Big Kontrasts tasting menu runs NOK 2,300, with wine pairings at NOK 1,700 (standard), NOK 2,450 (upgraded) and NOK 945 (alcohol-free).
quote: Big Kontrasts menu is 2,300 NOK. Beverage pairing: 1,700 NOK; Upgraded Beverage pairing: 2,450 NOK; Alcohol-free pairing: 945 NOK.

claim: Maaemo's room is a strikingly minimalist industrial space close to Oslo's old dock, with cooking that showcases Norway's rugged wilds.
quote: Maaemo is a strikingly minimalist restaurant in an industrial setting close to Oslo's old dock, headed up by Esben Holmboe Bang, with progressive cooking that showcases Norway's rugged wilds.

claim: Maaemo serves dinner Tuesday through Saturday from 18:00 to 24:00 and is closed Sunday and Monday.
quote: The restaurant is closed on Mondays and Sundays, and is open Tuesday through Saturday from 6 pm to 12 am.
